safety.browserProfiles: one isolated profile per browser lane
safety.ownership: Every destructive action requires a resource-ledger owner match; never touch unrelated tabs, profiles, processes, worktrees, or providers.

inputs.fixtureContract: Two Spaces, two tabs per Space where supported, multiple panes/agents, two disposable repositories/projects, changed and untracked files, context documents, source imports, pending browser feedback, and eligible plus ineligible delivery targets.

scheduler.readyRule: Run a node when every dependency has a terminal artifact satisfying its completion predicate; independent capture lanes run concurrently.
scheduler.handoffRule: Workers consume only declared artifact paths and publish an immutable receipt before marking complete.
scheduler.retryRule: Retry only the node's named disposable resources, never a parent or foreign resource; preserve each attempt receipt and diagnostics.
scheduler.inconclusiveRule: INCONCLUSIVE is terminal for a cell only after its max attempts, named capability/provider blocker, retained diagnostics, and cleanup receipt are present.
stopConditions: Stop the run as FAIL on any protected-session, unrelated-tab/profile, secret-retention, unauthorized-mutation, or cleanup-ownership violation.
Stop the run as INCONCLUSIVE when a required capability remains unavailable after escalation; do not relabel missing proof PASS.
Stop successfully only when every indexed scenario and every matrix cell is PASS, FAIL, or justified INCONCLUSIVE and the final validation and cleanup receipts exist.
scheduler.escalation: Escalate to the named Luna lead only for a genuine blocker (missing capability, contradictory authoritative evidence, unsafe ownership ambiguity, or repeated infrastructure failure); no escalation for ordinary assertion FAIL.

actions: Pin baseline commit and inspect all scenario indexes/rules
Create run ID, isolated roots, resource ledger, redaction policy, and artifact manifest
Inventory default Herdr session read-only without focusing or mutating it
phases.completionPredicate: bootstrap/receipt.json records commit, run ID, protected-session inventory, isolated resource identities, tool hashes, and an empty-of-secrets ledger; all resources are owned by this run.
phases.failureEscalation: Escalate only if ownership cannot be proven or an isolated profile/session cannot be created; stop on any protected-resource access.

actions: Create the disposable Herdr session and two Spaces
Create/open two tabs per Space where capability permits and populate multiple panes/agents
Create two disposable repository/project roots with changed and untracked files, context docs, source imports, pending feedback, and eligible/ineligible delivery targets
Record authoritative IDs and hashes without retaining credentials
phases.completionPredicate: fixture/receipt.json proves each requested fixture component or records a capability-scoped INCONCLUSIVE with command output, IDs, and no foreign mutation; snapshot and cleanup ownership are recorded.
phases.failureEscalation: Retry once with fresh fixture names after transient provisioning failure; escalate only unsupported capability, contradictory IDs, or unsafe partial provisioning.

phases.dispatch: Run every lane below concurrently; each lane owns a separate disposable browser/native/Herdr resource namespace and writes only its lane directory.

matrix.observableProof: Startup selects the owned session and sidebar shows both Spaces, tabs, agents, and selection persistence.
matrix.machineEvidence: session snapshot, authoritative IDs, DOM/accessibility dump, action log.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry once after reconnect; escalate only if session capability or IDs contradict.

matrix.observableProof: Both tabs and multiple panes render; command/pane menus open, select, and close without losing ownership.
matrix.machineEvidence: menu action log, focus events, pane/tab snapshot.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry with fresh tab; escalate only on persistent input-routing or capability blocker.

matrix.observableProof: Terminal scrollback, redraw, resize, keyboard, mouse/wheel, paste framing, and focus ownership are visible and correct.
matrix.machineEvidence: raw terminal transcript, resize dimensions, input/focus trace, renderer identity.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry once with a fresh pane; escalate only if renderer or focus capability is unavailable.

lanes.completionPredicate: Every indexed workbench scenario has a receipt with PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, required viewport captures, machine evidence, and cleanup result.

matrix.observableProof: Repository/artifact setup creates the owned workspace, shows canonical repo identity, and handles partial failure/recovery and teardown without deleting dirty data.
matrix.machineEvidence: operation records, workspace snapshot, repo status, resource ledger, cleanup receipt.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry with a new repository root once; escalate only unsupported method or ownership ambiguity.

matrix.observableProof: Tree/read/search, source import/refresh/remove, Markdown/Mermaid/image rendering, and containment/symlink behavior are observable.
matrix.machineEvidence: source hashes, file bounds, import records, DOM dump, redacted request log.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry once with reduced fixture payload; escalate only unavailable source/provider capability.

matrix.observableProof: Multi-file draft comments can be previewed, edited, removed, and safely handled when source is stale or paste delivery is pending.
matrix.machineEvidence: comment IDs/state transitions, stale-source response, pending-feedback log.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry once with a fresh draft; escalate only contradictory state or unavailable delivery target.

lanes.completionPredicate: Every indexed setup/context/review scenario has complete receipts, both viewport captures, machine evidence, and cleanup result.

matrix.observableProof: Owned extension/browser pairing becomes authoritative; Context, Review, and Terminal panes are detected and same-title false matches are rejected.
matrix.machineEvidence: tab identity, extension worker log, process provenance, pairing receipt.
matrix.retryEscalation: Reload owned extension once; escalate only if worker/capability remains unavailable.

matrix.observableProof: Visible-tab capture has stable anchors, annotation pairing, pending browser feedback, and eligible target delivery; ineligible target is refused.
matrix.machineEvidence: capture metadata, anchor coordinates, target eligibility decision, redacted message trace.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry once after tab stabilization; escalate only if target capability or pairing is unavailable.

matrix.observableProof: Close/reopen, disconnect, timeout, and resync preserve safe state and report unknown outcomes without duplicate delivery.
matrix.machineEvidence: lifecycle event trace, operation IDs, retry count, preserved draft and cleanup receipts.
matrix.retryEscalation: Induce each failure once, retry one recovery; escalate only contradictory at-most-once evidence.

lanes.completionPredicate: Every indexed browser scenario has complete receipts, both viewport captures, machine evidence, target eligibility proof, and cleanup result.

matrix.observableProof: Authorized disposable/read-only fixture hydrates issue/PR/wiki sources with bounded pagination and visible freshness/revision state.
matrix.machineEvidence: redacted request bounds, revision IDs, page counts, no-mutation audit.
matrix.retryEscalation: Retry once on timeout; escalate only absent credentials/capability, then mark INCONCLUSIVE.

lanes.completionPredicate: Each provider assertion is PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE with authorization, bounds, freshness, and no-mutation evidence.

actions: Join receipts by scenario ID, fixture identity, source commit, viewport, and operation ID
Compare browser/native/extension pane identity, context/review feedback, delivery eligibility, and cleanup ownership
Flag missing, stale, contradictory, or cross-resource evidence
phases.completionPredicate: joins.json maps every scenario and matrix cell to supporting artifacts and emits a discrepancy list with no silently dropped cells.
phases.failureEscalation: Retry join once after manifest refresh; escalate only irreconcilable authoritative contradiction.

actions: Check protected-session and unrelated-tab non-interference
Check secret redaction, source/runtime freshness, viewport dimensions, ownership, bounded calls, and cleanup
Attempt safe negative cases: ineligible target, stale source, timeout/disconnect, same-title false match, dirty teardown
phases.completionPredicate: audit.json records each invariant and negative case as PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE with retained diagnostics and points every issue to a cell or artifact.
phases.failureEscalation: Retry only an audit instrumentation failure; escalate genuine safety ambiguity immediately and stop on violation.

loop.until: coverage report has no unclassified/missing cells and every INCONCLUSIVE has named blocker and diagnostics
actions: Select highest-impact actionable gap from audit
Retry only that cell with fresh disposable resources or collect missing machine evidence
Re-run joins and adversarial checks for affected cells
Record attempt, reason, artifacts, and whether coverage improved
loop.noOpRule: Do not repair ordinary product FAILs or alter source code; record them as behavior results.
loop.escalation: Escalate after three targeted attempts, or immediately for safety/ownership contradiction; mark only affected cells INCONCLUSIVE with blocker.

phases.completionPredicate: repair-log.json proves loop termination by coverage closure, max retries, or explicit blocker; no unresolved unclassified cell remains.

actions: Validate JSON/schemaVersion and scenario IDs
Validate required provenance fields, both viewport captures, evidence classes, hashes, redaction, and result states
Validate coverage counts and artifact references against indexes
phases.completionPredicate: validation.json is PASS only when all structural and evidence rules pass; otherwise it identifies exact cells and leaves run non-success.
phases.failureEscalation: Retry after manifest-only correction once; escalate contradictory data or schema defect to Main.

actions: Verify ownership from ledger
Stop/delete only run-created Herdr session, browser profile, fixture repositories, servers, tabs, panes, and worktrees
Retain immutable receipts and diagnostics; record residuals and cleanup failures
phases.completionPredicate: cleanup.json lists every owned resource and action/result; no unowned resource was touched and residuals are explicit.
phases.failureEscalation: Retry only the owned resource action once; escalate residual cleanup failure and never broaden deletion scope.

finalPredicate: validation.json and cleanup.json pass; coverage.json contains one terminal result for every indexed scenario and matrix cell; all retained artifacts have provenance, SHA-256, redaction, and ownership evidence.

finalStates.FAIL: A required assertion or safety invariant is contradicted.
finalStates.INCONCLUSIVE: Only named unavailable capability, credentials, stale/contradictory evidence, or bounded exhausted attempts remain; diagnostics and cleanup are retained.
